facts.business: OCCL Limited operates in the specialised global insoluble sulphur segment within the tyre chemicals ecosystem, manufacturing insoluble sulphur and sulphuric acid/oleum.

capacity_or_capex.item: Sulphuric Acid and Oleum production capacity

guidance_or_targets.statement: OCCL reported an EBITDA margin of 18% in FY 2025–26 (18% in FY 2024-25), reflecting resilience.

key_risks: Foreign Exchange Risk due to export sales, domestic sales, and import of raw materials
Chinese manufacturers absorbing imported anti-dumping duties putting pressure on realisations in India
facts.related_party_note: The Board has approved a policy on dealing with related party transaction and same has been uploaded and available on the Company's website.
